title: Test code and evidence boundaries
description: Read test implementations test/drawdowns/tests_dev.js, test/drawdowns/tests_dist.js, test/ratios/test_sharpe-ratios_dev.js, test/ratios/tests_dist.js. Identify the behavior each assertion encodes, connect it to implementation, and distinguish a test file from an executed passing result. The test/configuration evidence is traced into implementation Gruntfile.js.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in test/drawdowns/tests_dev.js, test/drawdowns/tests_dist.js, test/ratios/test_sharpe-ratios_dev.js, test/ratios/tests_dist.js.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

practical_outcomes: Evidence map for test/drawdowns/tests_dev.js, test/drawdowns/tests_dist.js, test/ratios/test_sharpe-ratios_dev.js, test/ratios/tests_dist.js
completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
